name: droidforge-emulator-platform
description: Full Docker + Redroid Android Emulator Platform with Complete REST/WebSocket API, AI Agent Automation, Stealth Device Profiles, and Live Web Dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@droidforge/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@droidforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@droidforge/shared && npm run build --workspace=@droidforge/api && npm run build --workspace=@droidforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@droidforge/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@droidforge/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@droidforge/web
